title: Green Will Come Again
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The locusts came to Joel's land
And ate the fields all bare;
The hungry people stood and looked
At fields with nothing there.

[Chorus]
"Do not be afraid," the Lord said,
"Be glad, rejoice and sing!
I'll give you back the years you lost,
And every good green thing."

[Verse 2]
He promised rain at the right time,
And grass of softest green,
And fruit on trees, and wheat for bread,
Where only brown had been.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Scout's little pot sat brown and bare
Through all the winter long;
One morning there, a small green shoot!
He shouted, loud and strong.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
So when my own hard time feels long,
I'll thank Him for my bread;
He gives back what the locusts took
And fills my heart instead.

[Chorus]
mood: Growing music. A soft, even pulse under the voice like slow rain on a garden, steady from the first line and never hurried. Felt piano carrying the pulse in single notes, then opening into warmer chords as each verse goes on, the way one green shoot becomes a whole field. Glad rather than grand, brightest in the last chorus, music for the middle of a sunny day.
